name: CD79b molecule

function.text: CD79B encodes b-cell antigen receptor complex-associated protein beta chain. Annotated molecular activities include transmembrane signaling receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and immune response.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to agammaglobulinemia 6, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; Large B-cell lymphoma of immune-privileged sites. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
